Doto.source: Google Fonts css2 “Doto:ROND,wght@0..100,500..900” (variable; axes ROND 0–100, wght 100–900, default wght 900)
Doto.role: brand moments, titles, counters (never body text)

Martian Mono.source: Google Fonts css2 “Martian Mono:wght@400;500” — the served instance is “Martian Mono SemiExpanded” (default width). Bundle the same instance or the variable font pinned to the same width so advances match (≈0.70 em per glyph at 11 pt: “1 / 3” = 38.5 pt wide).
Martian Mono.role: labels, usernames, codes, counters, timestamps in pills

Inter.source: Google Fonts css2 “Inter:wght@400;500;600;700” (Inter 4, text optical size — not “Inter Display”)
Inter.role: all interface text; also the trailing “.” of Doto headlines (Inter 700)

SF Pro.role: only the system status bar (drawn by iOS, not the app)

defaultLineHeight.note: Nocturne body line-height; every Inter/Mono text without an explicit line-height inherits 1.55 × size

typography.lineHeightToSwiftUI: CSS line-height L with font size S and natural height N=S×naturalLineHeight: lineSpacing = L − N between lines, and (L − N)/2 extra padding above the first and below the last line to reproduce the CSS box height. When L < N (e.g. line-height:1 on Doto/Inter) clip nothing; the text box is L tall in CSS — use a fixed frame height of L for single-line labels.

displayPunctuation.size: same as the Doto run it ends
displayPunctuation.use: the trailing “.” of Doto headlines is set in Inter Bold at the same size/line-height

spacing.note: The iOS design uses literal point values (the Nocturne --space-* 0.7× scale is not used by these screens). These are all the paddings/gaps/margins that occur.

named.pill: height / 2 (all circles & capsules: avatars, icon buttons, keypad keys, toggles, chips with r=h/2)

shadow.note: CSS → SwiftUI: shadow(color, radius: blur/2, x, y). Negative spread (e.g. -8) = draw the glow from a shape inset by |spread| (or reduce radius); inset “0 0 0 Npx” = strokeBorder(N). Ring “0 0 0 Npx bg” = an outer stroke in the background colour (cut-out ring).

ringAccent.use: accent900 tiles/avatars (800 for tiles, 700 for self-avatar)

ringSelected.use: selected segmented chip (fill accent900, text accent300)

cutoutRing.use: online dot & reaction chip separation ring

blur.note: CSS blur(N) ≈ SwiftUI .blur(radius: N) for content blur; backdrop blurs map to a Material-free custom blur of the same radius over the given tint (do not use system materials — they shift hue).

privacyCover.css: content filter: blur(9px); opacity .75; tint bg·45%

motion.principle: Design rule: responsive, gentle ease-in-out with no bounce or overshoot. Reduce Motion: stop all infinite/ambient motion and replace movement with short cross-fades.

linePacket.timeline: 0–6%: fade in (opacity 0→1) · 0–60%: travel 0→100% of the line (left→right, or right→left) · 54–60%: fade out · 60–100%: idle
linePacket.element: 44×4 capsule, linear gradient transparent→accent200→transparent, glow 0 0 12 2 accent·50%, centred on the line (margin −22/−2)

pulseRing.element: circle 116 (Face ID) with 1.5pt accent400 stroke; on the live-location dot the same ring (116) centred on the dot

scene3D.pulses: 4 forward pulses, speed 0.17 line/s (≈ 5.9 s per crossing); 4 backward at 0.14 (≈ 7.1 s), amplitude 0.8
scene3D.lattice: tube lattice spins about the line at 0.25 rad/s; scan hex-ring sweeps every 3.125 s
scene3D.reduceMotion: design note: show a still frame (scene time frozen)

curveSoft.note: the design’s own curve — default for all transitions

springSoft.note: interactive moves (sheets following the finger, toggles, reaction bar) — critically damped, zero bounce

proposed.pressFeedback: scale 0.97 + fill brighten (text·9% → text·14% / accent tint 12%) over 0.06 s curveSoft, release 0.1 s
proposed.screenPush: cross-fade + 16 pt horizontal drift, 0.16 s curveOut (no parallax, no bounce)
proposed.sheet: system sheet presentation or custom: backdrop and sheet enter/exit over 0.18 s curveOut; springs only for drag hand-offs
proposed.codeDotFill: dot fills accent400 with scale 0.6→1 and glow fade-in, 0.1 s curveSoft
proposed.codeWrong: dots tint to danger over 0.1 s + soft horizontal shake (±6 pt, 3 damped cycles, 0.45 s), message fades in 0.12 s; dots clear after 0.8 s
proposed.setupAdvance: 6th digit → hold 0.25 s → cross-fade to the confirm step (2.2 note: “6 hane dolunca kendiliğinden ilerler”)
proposed.ghostUrgentFlip: pill/chip colours cross-fade to danger over 0.8 s when < 1 h remains
proposed.statusChange: message status icon cross-fades (0.12 s) sent → delivered → read
proposed.newMessage: bubble fades in + rises 8 pt, 0.12 s curveOut
proposed.lockCover: privacy cover appears instantly on resign-active (no animation — must hit the snapshot); unlock dissolves it over 0.12 s

scene3D.engine: design: three.js r160; iOS: SceneKit or RealityKit (design note). Canvas 402×330 pt at y = 84 on 1.1, transparent background over the bg + dot grid.

cups.placement: cup A at x = −L rotated +90° about z (opens to −x); cup B at x = +L rotated −90° (opens to +x); bottoms face each other
cups.rim: torus R 0.5075, tube 0.018, unlit edge colour
cups.wire: 18 meridians + rings at 0, 0.33H, 0.66H, unlit edge colour, opacity wireOp

scene3D.line: cylinder r 0.009 along x, length 2L, unlit line colour; glow: 180 soft dots size 0.24, opacity glowOp, additive (dark)
scene3D.pulses: 4 forward + 4 backward heads (soft sprite 0.2) with 4-sprite trails (0.16→0.10, spacing 0.014 of the line, opacity amp·(0.55 − 0.12j)); amp = smoothstep(0,.08,t)·(1 − smoothstep(.9,1,t)); colour core, additive
scene3D.lattice: hexagonal tube r 0.3, 13 rings × 6, scaled (2L·0.78, 0.73, 0.73), opacity tunnel·0.42 = 0.168; scan hex-ring opacity 0.36·sin(πs)
scene3D.relay: hex ring r 0.13 at the centre, spin 0.6 rad/s, opacity 0.08
scene3D.ends: soft sprite 0.55 at each cup bottom, opacity 0.3
scene3D.dust: 420 soft points in x∈[−8,8], y∈[−5,5], z∈[−6,3], size 0.045, opacity dustOp, drifting up
